name: decision-science-skills
description: Structured-judgment methods from intelligence, military, and forecasting practice: competing-hypotheses analysis, reference-class forecasting (outside view), pre-mortem, after-action review, tabletop wargaming with commander's intent, principled negotiation (Fisher/Ury + Voss), and the-challenger revision review (zero-based continue-vs-revise decisions that momentum and sunk costs suppress).
